description: Towards the use of UHPFRC in railway bridges: the rehabilitation of Buna Bridge is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Henar Martin-Sanz, Konstantinos Tatsis (ETH). Dataset of experiment carried out on Buna bridge, before rehabilitation. Accelerations corresponding to a roving test, with the positions and orientations specified ont the pdf (pass1 vertical, pass 2 vertical, pass1 horizontal, pass2 horizontal. The structure was excited with a shaker in horizontal (confH) and vertical (confV) positions. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
